newsitem.title: USA: Books-A-Million sees Q4 below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Books-A-Million sees Q4 below estimates.

text.p: Books-A-Million Inc said Friday a disappointing holiday season is expected to result in fourth quarter earnings below analysts' expectations.

"Results for the holiday season were disappointing," President and Chief Executive Clyde Anderson said in a statement. "A shortened selling period and the lack of dominant best-sellers contributed to the lower-than-expected figures.
"As a result of these factors, we expect earnings for the fourth quarter will most likely be significantly below analyst expectations."
The First Call mean estimate for the quarter is $0.39 per share.
